answer: At the dawn of each epoch a random sample of identities is audited against the public meadow of work receipts: every receipt must name a real counterparty who confirms the job and its outcome. Identities that pass repeated audits earn an ivory seal, a non-transferable mark that unlocks higher-value work. A sybil farmer must therefore fake not one identity but a whole web of confirming counterparties, each needing real paid work, so forging a thousand reputations costs about a thousand genuine jobs. Cheap copies fail the audit and forfeit their bond.
